sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

But as you progress through the game, you'll find that it's not as simple as it sounds. You'll need to think strategically about which vegetables to match, when to use special power-ups, and how to clear the board efficiently. The game also features a variety of obstacles, such as rocks, water, and mud, that will make it harder to clear the board.

As you match vegetables, you'll also earn coins and stars, which you can use to unlock new characters, power-ups, and levels. The game has a variety of power-ups, including bombs, magnets, and fish, that can help you clear the board faster and more efficiently. You can also use these power-ups to get extra stars and coins.

One of the things that sets Vegetables Rush apart from other match-3 games is its dynamic grid.
